categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Mempool' and modifies core mempool eviction structures by removing the CTxMempool entry_time multi_index and the EXPIRY eviction reason.
categories.rationale: Removes age-based eviction to prevent dropping mineable transactions such as low-feerate parents awaiting CPFP fee bumps. As detailed in issue #33510, expiring transactions by age is incentive-incompatible with mining and maintaining the index incurs unnecessary per-entry memory overhead.
